fields.label: Is Door Control
fields.description: Door controller: shown on /door_control and kept out of every attendance function. Only the 'Sync Fingerprint From ERP To Attendance Machines' dialog lists it (unticked, Door Control role only).

fields.label: Unlock Seconds
fields.description: How long the lock stays open when 'Open' is pressed on /door_control

fields.label: Sensor Installed
fields.description: Tick only on a door where a door sensor is really wired to the device's SEN/GND input. /door_control then shows Door open / closed for this door (needs Use Door Sensor in Door Alert Setting)

fields.label: Sensor Type
fields.description: How the sensor is wired (ZKTeco LB-35 / door contact = NO). Must match Door Sensor Mode on the device menu, otherwise /door_control ignores the sensor and shows a warning

fields.label: Allow Hold Open / Close
fields.description: Shows the 'Hold open' and 'Close' buttons. Leave off until it is verified on this device that 'Close' really locks the door early

fields.label: Send Door Alerts
fields.description: Telegram alerts (Door Alert Setting) watch this door. Untick to silence one door, e.g. while it is being repaired
